name: Mason Jar Shrimp Ramen Noodle Soup with Mixed Veggies (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, shrimp flavor
frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: Open ramen packages and set noodles aside for later use. Open and add seasoning packets to two (quart-sized) jars.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (3 oz) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, shrimp flavor

instructions.primary_message: Divide soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili-garlic sauce between the jars with the seasoning.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp soy sauce
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide frozen veggies between the jars.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables (carrots, corn, green beans, peas)

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Add to the jars.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 oz cooked shrimp, peeled, tail off

instructions.primary_message: Break noodles to fit (if necessary) and add to the jars.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)

When ready to eat, empty jar into a microwave safe bowl. Fill now-empty jar ⅔ full with water and add to the bowl. Microwave on high until veggies are warmed through and noodles are soft, about 6 minutes. Let sit 1 minute, then carefully remove from the microwave. (Alternatively, place jar contents and water in a medium saucepan, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until noodles are soft, 3-4 minutes.) Enjoy!
